title: cytisus austriacus subsp. heuffelii
intro: Cytisus austriacus subsp. heuffelii, commonly known as Austrian pea shrub, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the legume family Fabaceae. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues due to its various health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Cytisus austriacus subsp. heuffelii include anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and expectorant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal and therapeutic effects.
